variety_description: Early maturity, semi-dwarf, extra long slender, high yielding, aromatic and widely adaptable variety grown in India under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by IARI and released in 2013 for cultivation in the Basmati grown belt of North India. First early maturing Basmati rice around 25 days earlier than popular variety Pusa Basmati-1. Tolerant to lodging and grain shattering at maturity. Excellent grain and eating quality. Premum quality rice for export. Susceptible to major diseases.
